exposure: Robson's 10-group classification (characteristics of pregnant women related to parity, previous cesarean section, gestational age, onset of labor, fetal presentation, and number of fetuses)
outcome: Proportional contribution of each Robson's group to the total cesarean section rate
Proportional contribution of each Robson's group to the study population (women delivered by C-section)
cohort: Pregnant women who delivered at PGI YCMH, Pimpri, India, between January 2018 and December 2021.
finding: The hospital's overall cesarean section rate was 35.22%, with Robson Group 5 contributing the most significantly (44.57%) to the total C-section rate, and Group 2 having the highest representation among the C-section population (23.4%).
